lines:
Execution order: Markdown step 4 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 27 (Markdown 03/12 — Implement Markdown in Git text storage and recovery). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Extend adapter-to-adapter migration, project transfer and backup/restore so Markdown is never lost when storage changes.
Scope:
- Update ProjectImage and all closed transfer collections, staged validation, canonical counts and semantic fingerprints for complete bodies, external/portable identities, ordered associations, bindings, task/QA links and tombstones where applicable.
- Cover SQLite-to-text and text-to-SQLite in both directions, schema upgrades, recovery journals, source consistency checks and descriptor generation activation.
- Preserve source data and destination rollback behavior on validation/publication failures. Reject unknown records, invalid references and stale project handles.
- Keep generated .md files and local projection manifests outside canonical transfer data. After successful activation the output service can regenerate from the selected destination; generation failure must not report the already completed conversion as failed.
- Ensure extension points and pending SQL migration task 22 include this domain; do not add a fake server implementation.
Acceptance:
- Round-trip representative projects with project-scoped and architecture-associated documents, cross-document references, Unicode/fences, renamed titles, task/QA links and deletion history.
- Verify semantic equality, identities, complete data counts, rollback/recovery and retained unsaved desktop drafts across backend changes.
- Old projects without Markdown remain valid and read-only checks still pass.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.

data.title: Markdown 04/12 — Preserve documents through storage conversion and backup
